dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: Then I should go before I forget again. See you later, Sylvain.

dialogue.speaker: Sylvain
dialogue.text: Crests, families, expectations... People really do ruin lives over them.

dialogue.speaker: Sylvain
dialogue.text: And there I go, sounding cheerful again.

bridge_actions.text: Mercedes exits with a small wave.
Sylvain's hand lowers slowly after she leaves.
